name: Goals
description: Private long-running goals and evidence, with five chat tools under the host's approval rules and an active-goals data call for Today. The Today screen shows active goals. No memory sync jobs yet.

settings.label: Goals
settings.description: Goals can be reached through the Goals routes. Goals has no settings page, as before.

features.description: A person can list their goals in priority order, create a goal, change it, and close it by marking it completed or archived. Each person sees only their own goals.

errors.description: The goal does not exist or belongs to another person. Check the goal and try again.
The goal is completed or archived, so new evidence is refused. Reopen the goal to add evidence.

features.description: A person can add evidence to a goal that is still open, with its kind, source and summary. Adding evidence updates the goal's updated time.

Chat can list goals, read one with its ten newest evidence summaries, create, change and add evidence. Writes need the host’s one-use approval for the same person and exact inputs. A missing or another person’s goal is absent. No memory sync or approval screen is included yet.

errors.description: The tool cannot run without approval. Ask for approval for these exact inputs and try again.

features.description: The Today data call returns only the signed-in person’s active goals in priority order, newest first at equal priority. An empty list stays empty. The Today screen uses this call.

Today shows the signed-in person’s active goals under Focus and Long-term goals, with their target icon, priority and desired outcome, in the existing priority order. Completed and archived goals stay hidden. An empty list draws nothing. Loading is a quiet status line; a failed request offers Retry. This package screen has no editing or settings controls.

errors.description: Your goals could not be loaded. Retry the request, or reload Today if the screen itself could not open.

goals.list.description: List all goals in priority order.

goals.get.description: Read a goal and its ten newest evidence summaries.

goals.addEvidence.description: Add evidence to an open goal.
